title: Developmental pathways and career outcomes in Japanese professional football: analysis code, pre-specified analysis plan, and adjudicated gold-standard labels
description:
Code, version-controlled analysis plan and manually adjudicated gold-standard labels for an observational study of pre-professional developmental pathways (club academy, high school, university) and reaching J1 by age 25 among players observed in the Japanese professional leagues, 1999–2025.

What this deposit contains. The analysis plan and every revision to it, with the commit that fixed each version, so that the sequence of design decisions can be audited independently. The 539-player independent validation sample, drawn by stratified sampling and frozen before any rating began, with — for every one of the 773 verdicts — the source URL and the verbatim quotation the rater relied on. The two pre-specified measurement gates and their judgements. The sealed confirmatory run and the pooled estimand.

What it does not contain. Raw appearance records from the J.League Data Site, whose terms prohibit unauthorised reproduction, and cached article text. The collection scripts are included so that both can be re-derived from the sources.

Note on the result. The single pre-specified confirmatory test was not rejected, and the pre-specified measurement-robustness gate stopped the confirmatory interpretation: the misclassification rates the validation sample actually measured move the estimate past the tolerance fixed before the outcome was examined. The era-difference hypothesis is therefore reported as descriptive. The pathway gap itself is large in both eras.
